APARTMENT.example: They rented a quiet apartment near the MRT station last month.
APARTMENT.exampleZh: 他們上個月在捷運站附近租了一間安靜的公寓。

examples.en: My brother is painting his apartment this weekend.
examples.zh: 我弟弟這個週末正在粉刷他的公寓。

examples.en: Her new flat is bigger and brighter than her previous apartment.
examples.zh: 她的新住處比以前的公寓更大且更明亮。

ACTIVITY.example: The company organized an outdoor activity for all employees last week.
ACTIVITY.exampleZh: 公司上週為全體員工舉辦了一場戶外活動。

examples.en: Children are enjoying a fun drawing activity in the park.
examples.zh: 孩子們正在公園享受有趣的繪畫活動。

examples.en: Swimming was more popular than any other activity during the summer camp.
examples.zh: 在夏令營期間，游泳比任何其他活動都更受歡迎。

CALENDAR.example: I marked our project deadline on the calendar yesterday.
CALENDAR.exampleZh: 我昨天在行事曆上記下了我們專案的截止日。

examples.en: The assistant is updating the company calendar right now.
examples.zh: 特助現在正在更新公司的行事曆。

examples.en: The digital calendar is more useful than the paper calendar on my desk.
examples.zh: 數位行事曆比我桌上的紙本桌曆更實用。

EXPLAIN.example: The trainer explained the workplace safety rules clearly yesterday.
EXPLAIN.exampleZh: 培訓講師昨天清楚地解釋了職場安全守則。

examples.en: The guide is explaining the history of the temple to visitors.
examples.zh: 導遊正在向遊客解說這座寺廟的歷史。

examples.en: He gave the clearest presentation because he explained every detail well.
examples.zh: 他做了最清晰的簡報，因為他把每個細節都解釋得很到位。

COMFORTABLE.example: We stayed in a comfortable hotel during our holiday in Hualien.
COMFORTABLE.exampleZh: 我們在花蓮度假期間住了一家舒適的飯店。

examples.en: The tourists are relaxing in the comfortable lounge now.
examples.zh: 遊客們現在正在舒適的休息室裡放鬆。

examples.en: This leather chair is more comfortable than the wooden one in my office.
examples.zh: 這張皮椅比我辦公室的那張木椅舒服多了。

CONVENIENT.example: The new subway line made our daily commute much faster last year.
CONVENIENT.exampleZh: 新地鐵線去年讓我們的日常通勤變快了許多。

examples.en: More people are using this convenient app to order food right now.
examples.zh: 現在越來越多人正在使用這款便利的應用程式來訂餐。

examples.en: Living near a convenience store is more convenient than living in the mountains.
examples.zh: 住在便利商店附近比住在山區方便多了。

DESTINATION.example: Tainan was our favorite travel destination last summer.
DESTINATION.exampleZh: 台南是我們去年夏天最喜歡的旅遊目的地。

examples.en: The train is approaching its final destination at the moment.
examples.zh: 火車此刻正接近它的終點站目的地。

examples.en: Kyoto is the most popular destination among Taiwanese travelers.
examples.zh: 京都受台灣旅客歡迎的程度在所有目的地中名列前茅。

FAMOUS.example: This bakery became famous after winning an international competition in 2022.
FAMOUS.exampleZh: 這家烘焙坊在 2022 年贏得國際大賽後一舉成名。

examples.en: Crowds of food lovers are waiting outside this famous beef noodle restaurant.
examples.zh: 許多美食愛好者正在這家著名的牛肉麵店外排隊等候。

examples.en: Alishan is more famous than many other national parks in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 阿里山比台灣許多其他國家公園更加出名。

AUTUMN.example: Many tourists visited Mount Fuji during autumn last year.
AUTUMN.exampleZh: 去年秋天許多遊客造訪了富士山。

examples.en: The maple leaves are turning bright red this autumn.
examples.zh: 今年秋天楓葉正在逐漸轉為鮮紅。

examples.en: Autumn in Taipei is cooler and more pleasant than summer.
examples.zh: 台北的秋天比夏天涼爽舒適許多。

COURSE.example: She took an online English speaking course last semester.
COURSE.exampleZh: 她上學期上了一門線上英語口說課程。

examples.en: Several university students are attending an advanced business course today.
examples.zh: 幾位大學生今天正在上一門進階商業課程。

examples.en: This photography course was more practical than my previous art class.
examples.zh: 這門攝影課程比我以前的藝術課更加實用。

PRACTICE.example: They practiced conversational English for two hours last night.
PRACTICE.exampleZh: 他們昨晚練習了兩小時的日常英語會話。

examples.en: The school band is practicing modern music in the hall right now.
examples.zh: 學校樂隊現在正在大廳練習現代音樂。

examples.en: She practiced speaking more frequently than her classmates before the exam.
examples.zh: 在考試前，她比班上同學更頻繁地練習口說。

RELATIVE.example: All of our relatives gathered in Kaohsiung during the New Year holiday.
RELATIVE.exampleZh: 過年連假期間我們所有的親戚都在高雄相聚。

examples.en: My parents are visiting our elderly relatives in the countryside today.
examples.zh: 我的父母今天正在鄉下探望我們年長的親戚。

examples.en: Uncle David is the most humorous relative in our big family.
examples.zh: 大衛叔叔是我們大家庭中最幽默風趣的親戚。

FURNITURE.example: We bought modern wooden furniture for our new living room yesterday.
FURNITURE.exampleZh: 我們昨天為新客廳買了現代風的木製家具。

examples.en: The delivery workers are moving heavy furniture up the stairs.
examples.zh: 搬運工人正在把沉重的家具搬上樓梯。

examples.en: This sofa was the most expensive piece of furniture in the showroom.
examples.zh: 這張沙發是展示中心裡最昂貴的一件家具。

CHANNEL.example: My father watched the evening sports channel yesterday after dinner.
CHANNEL.exampleZh: 我父親昨天晚餐後看了晚間體育頻道。

examples.en: The kids are watching an educational cartoon channel right now.
examples.zh: 孩子們現在正在收看一個益智卡通頻道。

examples.en: This travel channel is more popular than the domestic news channel.
examples.zh: 這個旅遊頻道比國內新聞頻道更受歡迎。

PROGRAMME.example: We watched an interesting cooking programme on television last night.
PROGRAMME.exampleZh: 我們昨晚在電視上看了一個有趣的烹飪節目。

examples.en: The studio is recording a popular music programme tonight.
examples.zh: 攝影棚今晚正在錄製一個受歡迎的音樂節目。

examples.en: That nature documentary was the most educational programme of the year.
examples.zh: 那部大自然紀錄片是今年最具教育意義的節目。

HEALTH.example: Daily exercise improved his cardiovascular health significantly last year.
HEALTH.exampleZh: 每天運動在去年顯著改善了他的心血管健康。

examples.en: More adults are caring about their mental health these days.
examples.zh: 如今有越來越多成年人關心自身的心理健康。

examples.en: Good physical health is more valuable than accumulated wealth.
examples.zh: 良好的身體健康比積累的財富更為珍貴。

THEATRE.example: We visited the national theatre and saw a wonderful musical last Friday.
THEATRE.exampleZh: 我們上週五造訪了國家劇院並欣賞了一場精彩的音樂劇。

examples.en: Audiences are entering the main theatre for the evening show.
examples.zh: 觀眾們現在正步入主劇院準備觀賞晚間演出。

examples.en: This historic theatre is older than any cinema in our town.
examples.zh: 這座歷史悠久的劇院比我們鎮上的任何一家電影院都要古老。

STORM.example: A strong storm caused several road closures on the east coast last weekend.
STORM.exampleZh: 一場強烈暴風雨上週末導致東海岸數條道路封閉。

examples.en: A heavy storm is passing over northern Taiwan right now.
examples.zh: 一場劇烈的風暴目前正掠過北台灣上空。

examples.en: This summer storm was louder and wetter than the previous typhoon.
examples.zh: 這場夏季暴風雨比上一次颱風更吵雜、雨勢也更大。

EXAMINATION.example: All applicants completed the formal language examination yesterday morning.
EXAMINATION.exampleZh: 所有應徵者昨天上午都完成了這場正式的語言測驗。

examples.en: The students are writing their final examination in room 302.
examples.zh: 學生們正在 302 教室進行期末考試作答。

examples.en: The written examination was harder than the speaking interview.
examples.zh: 這場筆試比口語面試還要困難得多。

TEMPERATURE.example: The nurse took my body temperature twice yesterday morning.
TEMPERATURE.exampleZh: 護理師昨天早上量了兩次我的體溫。

examples.en: The outdoor temperature is dropping rapidly because cold air is arriving.
examples.zh: 因為冷空氣來襲，室外氣溫此刻正急速下降。

examples.en: Today has the lowest temperature recorded in this mountain area.
examples.zh: 今天記錄到了該山區有史以來的最低氣溫。

AMBULANCE.example: An ambulance arrived outside our building within five minutes yesterday.
AMBULANCE.exampleZh: 昨天一輛救護車在五分鐘內就抵達了我們大樓外。

examples.en: The ambulance is rushing to the hospital with loud sirens.
examples.zh: 救護車正鳴著大聲的警笛全速開往醫院。

examples.en: Calling an ambulance is faster than driving a private car in an emergency.
examples.zh: 在緊急情況下，叫救護車比開私家車更快到達醫院。

PASSENGER.example: Every passenger wore a seatbelt on the coach bus yesterday.
PASSENGER.exampleZh: 每位乘客昨天在長途客運上都繫好了安全帶。

examples.en: Passengers are waiting patiently inside the international terminal right now.
examples.zh: 乘客們現在正耐心地在國際航廈內部等候。

examples.en: This new subway line carried more passengers than the old rapid line.
examples.zh: 這條新捷運線運送的旅客人數比舊快捷線更多。

EXCITING.example: We watched an exciting baseball game at the stadium last night.
EXCITING.exampleZh: 我們昨晚在體育場看了一場令人興奮的棒球賽。

examples.en: The band is planning an exciting concert tour for their fans.
examples.zh: 該樂團目前正在為歌迷籌劃一場令人興奮的巡迴演唱會。

examples.en: Traveling across the country was the most exciting journey of my adult life.
examples.zh: 跨國旅行是我成年生活中最令人熱血沸騰的一趟旅程。

DANGEROUS.example: Driving along the rocky mountain highway was very dangerous during the storm.
DANGEROUS.exampleZh: 暴風雨期間沿著多石的山區公路行駛非常危險。

examples.en: The strong sea waves are becoming dangerous for amateur swimmers.
examples.zh: 強勁的海浪對業餘游泳者來說正變得越來越危險。

examples.en: Riding a scooter in heavy rain is more dangerous than taking the subway.
examples.zh: 在傾盆大雨中騎機車比搭乘捷運危險得多。

ARCHITECT.example: The talented architect designed this modern library three years ago.
ARCHITECT.exampleZh: 那位有才華的建築師三年前設計了這座現代圖書館。

examples.en: The chief architect is presenting the new building plans right now.
examples.zh: 首席建築師此刻正在展示新的大樓設計圖。

examples.en: She was more famous than any other architect in our city.
examples.zh: 她比我們城市裡的任何其他建築師都更出名。

CHEF.example: The head chef prepared a special dinner for the guests last night.
CHEF.exampleZh: 主廚昨晚為客人準備了特別的晚餐。

examples.en: The chef is cooking fresh seafood soup in the open kitchen right now.
examples.zh: 廚師現在正在開放式廚房裡煮新鮮海鮮湯。

examples.en: He is the most experienced chef in this Italian restaurant.
examples.zh: 他是這家義大利餐廳裡經驗最豐富的廚師。

ENVELOPE.example: I put the signed contract inside a white envelope yesterday.
ENVELOPE.exampleZh: 我昨天把簽好的合約放進了一個白色信封裡。

examples.en: The secretary is sealing a large envelope at her desk right now.
examples.zh: 秘書現在正在座位上封存一個大信封。

examples.en: This padded envelope is stronger than the standard paper envelope.
examples.zh: 這款氣泡防震信封比標準紙信封更加結實。

SCISSORS.example: He cut the cardboard boxes with sharp scissors yesterday afternoon.
SCISSORS.exampleZh: 他昨天下午用鋒利的剪刀裁開了紙箱。

examples.en: She is cutting color paper with safety scissors for the exhibition.
examples.zh: 她正為了展覽用安全剪刀裁剪色紙。

examples.en: These stainless steel scissors are sharper than my old pair.
examples.zh: 這把不銹鋼剪刀比我的舊剪刀鋒利多了。

NERVOUS.example: I felt nervous before giving the English presentation yesterday morning.
NERVOUS.exampleZh: 我昨天早上做英語簡報之前感到非常緊張。

examples.en: The candidates are feeling nervous while waiting for the interview results.
examples.zh: 應徵者在等待面試結果時正感到焦慮緊張。

examples.en: She was more nervous today than she was during the practice session.
examples.zh: 她今天比練習階段時更加緊張不安。

DOLPHIN.example: We saw a friendly dolphin swim beside our tourist boat yesterday.
DOLPHIN.exampleZh: 我們昨天看到一隻友善的海豚在遊船旁邊游動。

examples.en: A playful dolphin is jumping out of the clear ocean water.
examples.zh: 一隻頑皮的海豚正躍出清澈的海面。

examples.en: The dolphin is often considered the smartest animal in marine biology.
examples.zh: 在海洋生物學中，海豚常被視為最聰明的動物。

DESSERT.example: We ordered delicious mango shaved ice for dessert last night.
DESSERT.exampleZh: 我們昨晚點了美味的芒果雪花冰當作甜點。

examples.en: The pastry chef is baking a chocolate dessert in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 西點師傅正在廚房烘烤巧克力甜品。

examples.en: This seasonal fruit tart was sweeter than the matcha cake dessert.
examples.zh: 這款當季水果塔比抹茶蛋糕甜點還要甜。

JOURNALIST.example: The experienced journalist reported the breaking local news yesterday afternoon.
JOURNALIST.exampleZh: 那位資深記者昨天下午報導了這則突發的地方新聞。

examples.en: Several foreign journalists are interviewing the mayor in the city hall.
examples.zh: 幾位外國記者正在市政廳採訪市長。

examples.en: She became the most respected journalist in the newsroom last year.
examples.zh: 她去年成為新聞編輯部裡最受人尊敬的記者。

MONITOR.example: My company bought a curved computer monitor for my desk last week.
MONITOR.exampleZh: 我們公司上週為我的辦公桌買了一台曲面電腦螢幕。

examples.en: The programmer is looking at high-resolution charts on the monitor right now.
examples.zh: 工程師現在正注視著螢幕上的高解析度圖表。

examples.en: This widescreen monitor is brighter than the old display screen.
examples.zh: 這台寬螢幕顯示器比舊螢幕更加清晰明亮。

GENEROUS.example: Our boss gave us a generous year-end bonus last January.
GENEROUS.exampleZh: 我們老闆去年一月發給了我們一筆慷慨豐厚的年終獎金。

examples.en: The community members are making generous donations to the charity right now.
examples.zh: 社區居民現在正在向慈善機構提供慷慨的捐贈。

examples.en: Uncle Thomas is the most generous person in our entire neighborhood.
examples.zh: 湯瑪斯叔叔是我們整個社區中最慷慨大度的人。

MONUMENT.example: We walked around the historic monument near the harbor yesterday morning.
MONUMENT.exampleZh: 我們昨天上午在港口附近的歷史紀念碑周圍散步。

examples.en: Travelers are taking group photos near the stone monument.
examples.zh: 旅客們正在這座石質紀念碑附近拍攝團體照。

examples.en: This white marble monument is taller than the old clock tower.
examples.zh: 這座白色大理石紀念碑比那座舊鐘樓還要高大。

SCENERY.example: We enjoyed the breathtaking mountain scenery during our trip to Taroko last year.
SCENERY.exampleZh: 我們去年去太魯閣旅行時欣賞了令人屏息的山景風光。

examples.en: Passengers on the mountain train are admiring the lush scenery right now.
examples.zh: 登山火車上的乘客們現在正讚嘆著蔥鬱的秀麗風光。

examples.en: The seaside scenery in Kenting is more picturesque than the city landscape.
examples.zh: 墾丁的海岸風光比都市景觀更加如詩如畫。

RECIPE.example: My mother shared an authentic beef noodle recipe with me yesterday.
RECIPE.exampleZh: 我母親昨天跟我分享了一份道地的牛肉麵食譜配方。

examples.en: He is following an easy pasta recipe on his mobile phone.
examples.zh: 他現在正照著手機上的簡易義大利麵食譜做料理。

examples.en: This traditional baking recipe is simpler than the French pastry guide.
examples.zh: 這份傳統烘焙食譜比那本法式點心指南還要簡單容易。

ENGINEER.example: The software engineer solved the critical database issue yesterday.
ENGINEER.exampleZh: 那位軟體工程師昨天解決了嚴重的資料庫問題。

examples.en: The mechanical engineer is inspecting the manufacturing machines in the factory.
examples.zh: 機械工程師正在工廠檢查生產製造機具。

examples.en: She was more analytical than other junior engineers in the department.
examples.zh: 她比該部門內其他資淺的工程師都更具備分析能力。

CONFIDENT.example: The job candidate gave confident answers throughout the interview yesterday.
CONFIDENT.exampleZh: 求職者昨天在整個面試過程中展現了充滿信心的回答。

examples.en: The public speaker is looking very confident on the stage.
examples.zh: 那位演講者在舞台上看起來非常充滿自信。

examples.en: He became more confident after practicing English conversations daily.
examples.zh: 在每天練習英語對話後，他變得更加自信從容。

CATHEDRAL.example: We visited the magnificent Gothic cathedral during our tour of Europe.
CATHEDRAL.exampleZh: 我們在歐洲旅行期間參觀了這座宏偉的哥德式大教堂。

examples.en: Tourists are admiring the colorful stained glass windows inside the cathedral.
examples.zh: 遊客們正在大教堂內欣賞色彩斑斕的彩繪玻璃窗。

examples.en: This historic cathedral is larger than any local church in the region.
examples.zh: 這座歷史悠久的大教堂比該地區任何在地教堂都還要巨大。

DOWNLOAD.example: I downloaded the mobile banking application onto my phone yesterday.
DOWNLOAD.exampleZh: 我昨天將行動網銀應用程式下載到了手機裡。

examples.en: She is downloading large presentation files using high-speed Wi-Fi.
examples.zh: 她現在正利用高速無線網路下載大型簡報檔案。

examples.en: Downloading podcast episodes was faster than streaming audio on the train.
examples.zh: 在火車上下載播客單集比直接線上串流音檔順暢快速。

DISAPPOINTED.example: We were very disappointed because the outdoor performance was canceled.
DISAPPOINTED.exampleZh: 因為戶外演出被取消，我們當時感到非常失望。

examples.en: The manager is feeling disappointed about the weak quarterly sales figures.
examples.zh: 經理目前對疲弱的季度銷售業績感到相當失望。

examples.en: He looked more disappointed than his team members after the match.
examples.zh: 比賽結束後，他看起來比隊友們更加沮喪失落。

SKYSCRAPER.example: They built an impressive glass skyscraper in the commercial district in 2024.
SKYSCRAPER.exampleZh: 他們於 2024 年在商業中心建造了一棟令人驚艷的玻璃摩天大樓。

examples.en: Workers are cleaning the upper exterior windows of the skyscraper.
examples.zh: 工人們現在正在清洗摩天大樓高層的外窗。

examples.en: Taipei 101 was the tallest skyscraper in the world when completed.
examples.zh: 台北 101 大樓竣工時曾是全世界最高的摩天大樓。

ENVIRONMENT.example: The eco-friendly company protected the natural forest environment last year.
ENVIRONMENT.exampleZh: 這家注重環保的企業去年大力保護了天然的森林環境。

examples.en: Scientists are studying how pollution is affecting the ocean environment.
examples.zh: 科學家們現在正在研究污染如何影響海洋自然環境。

examples.en: Working in a quiet office environment is better than working in a noisy room.
examples.zh: 在安靜的辦公室環境中工作比在吵雜的房間裡好得多。

INGREDIENT.example: I purchased fresh vegetable ingredients at the organic market yesterday.
INGREDIENT.exampleZh: 我昨天在有機市集購買了新鮮的蔬菜食材原料。

examples.en: The cook is mixing all the fresh ingredients in a large wooden bowl.
examples.zh: 廚子現在正把所有新鮮的食材混合在一個大木碗中。

examples.en: Pure olive oil was the most essential ingredient in the Mediterranean salad.
examples.zh: 純橄欖油是地中海沙拉中最不可或缺的核心食材。

WEBSITE.example: Our company launched a new official website two months ago.
WEBSITE.exampleZh: 我們公司兩個月前推出了全新的官方網站。

examples.en: The graphic designer is updating the website with modern responsive layouts.
examples.zh: 平面設計師正以現代響應式排版來更新該網站。

examples.en: This travel booking website is more user-friendly than older travel portals.
examples.zh: 這家旅遊預訂網站比舊版的旅遊門戶網站更方便易用。

PHOTOGRAPHER.example: The wedding photographer took wonderful pictures of our family last Sunday.
PHOTOGRAPHER.exampleZh: 婚禮攝影師上週日為我們全家拍攝了非常棒的照片。

examples.en: The nature photographer is waiting patiently for wild birds in the woods.
examples.zh: 自然生態攝影師正在樹林裡耐心地等待野生鳥類。

examples.en: She was the most creative photographer in the commercial portrait studio.
examples.zh: 她是那家商業人像攝影棚裡最具創意的攝影師。

SCREEN.example: I bought a new computer screen.
SCREEN.exampleZh: 我買了一個新的電腦螢幕。

examples.en: I bought a new computer screen.
examples.zh: 我買了一個新的電腦螢幕。

examples.en: Don't look at the screen for too long.
examples.zh: 不要看螢幕太久。

ARTICLE.example: She wrote an article about health.
ARTICLE.exampleZh: 她寫了一篇關於健康的文章。

examples.en: She wrote an article about health.
examples.zh: 她寫了一篇關於健康的文章。

examples.en: I am reading an interesting article.
examples.zh: 我正在讀一篇有趣的文章。

MAGAZINE.example: He buys a sports magazine every week.
MAGAZINE.exampleZh: 他每週買一本體育雜誌。

examples.en: He buys a sports magazine every week.
examples.zh: 他每週買一本體育雜誌。

examples.en: There are some magazines on the table.
examples.zh: 桌上有一些雜誌。

FESTIVAL.example: The music festival is in July.

examples.en: The music festival is in July.
examples.zh: 音樂節在七月。

examples.en: They celebrate the spring festival.
examples.zh: 他們慶祝春節。

ACCIDENT.example: He had a car accident yesterday.

examples.en: He had a car accident yesterday.
examples.zh: 他昨天發生了車禍。

examples.en: It was just an accident.
examples.zh: 這只是一場意外。

WALLET.example: I lost my wallet on the bus.
WALLET.exampleZh: 我在公車上弄丟了皮夾。

examples.en: I lost my wallet on the bus.
examples.zh: 我在公車上弄丟了皮夾。

examples.en: He put his money in the wallet.
examples.zh: 他把錢放進皮夾裡。

CASTLE.exampleZh: 我們參觀了一座古老的城堡。

examples.en: We visited an old castle.
examples.zh: 我們參觀了一座古老的城堡。

examples.en: The king lived in the castle.
examples.zh: 國王住在城堡裡。

TEMPLE.example: They went to the temple to pray.

examples.en: They went to the temple to pray.
examples.zh: 他們去寺廟祈禱。

examples.en: This temple is very famous.
examples.zh: 這座寺廟非常有名。

BORDER.exampleZh: 他們安全地越過了邊界。

examples.en: They crossed the border safely.
examples.zh: 他們安全地越過了邊界。

examples.en: The river is the natural border.
examples.zh: 這條河是天然的邊界。

examples.en: The car engine broke down.
examples.zh: 汽車引擎故障了。

examples.en: He knows how to fix the engine.
examples.zh: 他知道如何修理引擎。
